summary: Planned Sprint 3 authentication delivery across architecture, data, API, UI, QA, and security without duplicating any listed task.

new_tasks.title: Audit and confirm the standard-library JWT authentication contract, including token claims, password hashing, error responses, and task ownership boundaries.
Verify and complete the users/task-ownership schema migration in database.py for authentication and per-user task isolation.
Verify and complete register/login, HS256 JWT verification, Bearer protection, and per-user task authorization in server.py.
Complete the login/register UI and session-scoped Bearer-token integration in static/index.html.
Test registration, login, invalid and expired token handling, protected task routes, and cross-user task isolation.
Review the completed authentication implementation for password storage, JWT validation, token handling, and authorization bypasses.

messages.content: Confirm the existing authentication work against the Sprint 3 contract before downstream verification.
Resume the interrupted authentication UI work after the backend contract verification is complete.
Use the final API implementation to cover authenticated and cross-user task workflows.
Review the completed server implementation for JWT and ownership enforcement.

decisions: Sprint 3 continues to require Python standard library only; no JWT, web, or frontend packages may be added.
Authentication remains session-scoped in the browser, and every task query or mutation must be restricted to the authenticated JWT subject.
